scene_description: Light gray wood-grain desk along a wall with a power-outlet strip at its back edge. An unplugged charger block stands on the desk top, and a whiteboard eraser lies on the seat of a wooden stool in front of the desk. Front is the edge away from the wall.

targets.name: charger block
targets.description: Small black charger block standing on the desk top with its plug prongs pointing up, near the middle of the desk.

targets.name: whiteboard eraser
targets.description: Gray felt whiteboard eraser lying flat on the seat of the wooden stool in front of the desk.
targets.clearance_notes: Open seat surface on all sides and nothing overhead.

source: Staged permutation of S0037 and S0039, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
